prompt: Create a highly detailed photorealistic vertical portrait of a young East Asian girl wearing a pale blue floral kimono, seated at a white table outdoors in soft daylight. She has dark brown shoulder-length softly wavy hair parted to the side, smooth porcelain skin, delicate youthful features, subtle pink makeup, and a calm introspective expression as she looks downward slightly. Her left cheek rests gently on her left hand, with her elbow on the table; her other arm is folded in front of her inside the kimono sleeve. Add exactly 2 visible gold-and-pearl accessories: an ornate floral hairpin with dangling chains on the right side of her hair, and a matching dangling floral earring on her right ear. The kimono should be dusty pale blue with a white inner collar and an elegant pattern of cream and blush cherry blossoms with fine gold branches across the sleeves and bodice. Use a shallow depth of field with a softly blurred green-and-white outdoor background, creamy bokeh, natural window-like sunlight, gentle highlights on the hair and fabric, realistic skin texture, crisp facial detail, and a serene refined atmosphere. Frame as a close medium portrait from chest to head, vertical 2:3 composition, centered subject, no text, no watermark, no extra people.
